newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes higher against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes higher against dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed higher at 43.7700/8000 to the dollar in interbank trading on Thursday against the previous close at 43.8200/8300, dealers said.
Dealers said the local unit weakened slightly after opening at 43.7550/7650 but recovered to close higher as demand for the greenback was weak.
The interbank call money rates closed at 7.5 percent to 9.5 percent against the previous eight to nine percent, dealers said.
